project_type: Standalone MCP server (TypeScript) + Next.js React UI
build_system: npm with tsc (TypeScript compiler) for MCP server, Next.js for UI
verification_instructions: 1. Build: npm run build 2. Test: npm test (expect Part A 45 tests + new IoT tests) 3. Start: MCP_TRANSPORT=http node dist/index.js 4. Manual: curl POST /webhooks/telemetry, curl GET /sse/:zoneId, open /digital-twin in browser
snapshot_or_generated_files: dist/* files generated by tsc. Run 'npm run build' to regenerate after source changes.
environment_constraints: Part A (27 tools, LedgerEvent schema, BondedLedger, RBAC, 45 tests) is complete and locked. NEVER modify src/types/events.ts. NEVER modify Part A test files (tests/tools.spec.ts, tests/auth.spec.ts, tests/ledger.spec.ts) except to update tool count assertion. HTTP transport layer location unknown - must be discovered during implementation (likely in main entry point or transport module).
contribution_requirements: All Part B work is additive. No Part A modifications except: (1) add 7 IoT tools to src/tools/index.ts tools array, (2) add 4 IoT resources to src/resources/index.ts, (3) update TOOL_COUNT from 27 to 34, (4) add HTTP endpoints to transport layer. LedgerEvent schema is immutable - IoT events use existing fields (zone='IOT', actor='device:<deviceId>', eventType='iot.telemetry.received', deviceId, payload).
key_patterns: Tool handlers: async functions returning { type: 'text', text: JSON.stringify(data) }[]. RBAC: call setToolTier(name, 'read'|'write'|'privileged'|'agent'). Ledger append: await ledger.append({ eventType, zone, actor, deviceId, payload, ...optional }). Resources: server.resource(name, uri, async () => ({ contents: [{ uri, mimeType, text }] })). Tests: vitest describe/it blocks with expect assertions. RateLimiter: existing class in src/middleware/rateLimit.ts with check(key) method.
directory_structure: mcp/tradeops-server/src/{types,backend,tools,resources,auth,middleware,iot(new)}, mcp/tradeops-server/tests/, components/ (for React UI). New iot/ directory holds: deviceRegistry.ts, telemetryNormalizer.ts, webhookHandler.ts, zoneGraphUpdater.ts, sseBroadcaster.ts. New tools/iot.ts for 7 IoT MCP tools. New resources/devices.ts and resources/telemetry.ts for 4 IoT MCP resources. New tests/iot.spec.ts and tests/integration.spec.ts for comprehensive IoT test coverage. New components/DigitalTwin.tsx for React Flow UI.
